facts.fact: PROCASEF reports that its communal land information system SIFCOM is planned to be operational in the 136 communal land offices of the project, with an electronic land book announced to replace paper registers.

PROCASEF reports that SIFCOM is planned to be operational in the 136 communal land offices of the project, and that an electronic land book is announced to replace paper registers in the land conservation offices.

SEN.note: SIFCOM is an application for communal land offices; no office connection is stated.
